profile.headline: Software Developer Analyst II at Black Hills Energy
profile.geoLocationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunications industry. Skilled in C#, C++, C++/CLI, and SQL. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Computer Science from South Dakota School of Mines and Technology.

positions.title: Software Developer Analyst II
positions.locationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
positions.description: Support and maintain the customer information system (CIS). Modify existing software to make it more effective and efficient for users. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to analysts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
positions.description: Develop features and implement bug fixes across a range of .NET/C++/VB6 based technologies and applications. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to software developers, other software engineers, and interns. Engage with project team members to ensure technical integrity and successful delivery of software products and projects. Participate in all phases of the software development process.

positions.title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Agent
positions.locationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
positions.description: Monitor the network for alarms and disruptions in service. Responsible for ensuring service reliability and quality by following set procedures when dealing with fault isolation, outages and escalations. Entering detailed and accurate information in trouble tickets and company notifications.

positions.title: Scientific Programmer
positions.locationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
positions.description: Designed and developed a MATLAB program that controls Microwave Studio.

company.name: South Dakota School of Mines and Technology

positions.title: College Algebra Lab Team Lead
positions.locationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
positions.description: Lead college Algebra lab by answering questions over homework, quizzes, and tests. Administered and corrected weekly quizzes.

positions.title: Senior Helpdesk Technician
positions.locationName: Rapid City, South Dakota, United States
positions.description:

                  Technician responsibilities include helping level 1 and level 2 technicians,

positions.description: Responded to cardholders in a professional, accurate and efficient manner. Provided appropriate follow-up to ensure cardholder satisfaction and performed appropriate account maintenance.
